verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents developer API keys, but nothing in the evidence shows they can be scoped or limited to least privilege. The docs describe them as full live credentials: anyone with the key can use the API. The fine-grained admin controls, RBAC and permissions it mentions apply to users, not to API credentials, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
